column1: # Per-suite assertion floors — what each SQL suite must still prove.
# WHY. CI counted SUITES, not CHECKS: it compared the number of files in supabase/tests against the
# number that printed "ALL CHECKS PASSED". A suite gutted to a single assertion still prints it, so
# a whole wall could be deleted from the suite and the build would stay green with a tick that
# meant "31 files ran". A check that cannot fail is not a check.
# HOW TO USE. Each line is <suite> <TAB> <the number of PASS assertions it must reach>. CI runs
# scripts/check-suite-counts.sh over the test log and fails any suite that comes in under its
# number. Adding checks is meant to be easy and REMOVING them is meant to be visible: when you add
# assertions, raise the number here in the same commit and the diff shows exactly what changed.
# Generated from a clean run on 13 September 2026: 31 suites, 1,416 assertions, all passing.
